name: cbio-normal-skin-melanocytes-2024
description: Whole exome sequencing and targeted sequencing data of 308 normal melanocytes samples from human skin. In addition to data retrieved from four different articles, the study is part of a broader analysis involving three distinct cell types, with findings stratified accordingly (see related fibroblasts and keratinocytes studies).

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
